Selection for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026 is based on a computer-based online examination followed by document verification and district-wise counselling.

The exam is conducted online in two shifts per day. Minimum qualifying marks are 50% for unreserved candidates and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates (a 10% relaxation from the unreserved cut-off). EWS candidates also get a 10% relaxation on the minimum qualifying marks as per the applicable government circular.
MPESB will prepare a percentile-based merit list of qualified candidates. District allotment is done through a single round of counselling
based on the district preferences candidates submitted in their application form
matched against merit rank and category-wise vacancy. Once a district is allotted in this first counselling
it is final; there is no additional round of counselling for candidates who remain absent or are found ineligible at the document verification stage
and any such vacant post is carried forward to a future recruitment cycle rather than filled through extra counselling.

Visit the official MPESB website at www.esb.mp.gov.in.
Locate and open the Group-2 Sub-Group-4 (Patwari PwD Category) Recruitment 2026 application link.
Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details.
Select district preferences in order, since this cannot be changed after submission.
Upload the required documents as specified in the notification.
Pay the applicable application fee and portal fee online.
Submit the form and save/print a copy of the confirmation for future reference.
important_instructions: Aadhaar registration is mandatory for all candidates. Candidates must carry an original photo ID (Voter ID, PAN, Aadhaar, Driving Licence, or Passport) to the exam centre; e-Aadhaar is valid only if UIDAI-verified. Multi-level biometric verification is compulsory at entry and during the exam; Aadhaar must be unlocked for this verification. Candidates will not be permitted entry after the reporting time. Mobile phones, calculators, log tables, digital watches, sunglasses, and unfair means material are strictly prohibited in the exam hall. Candidates must bring a black ball-point pen and their downloaded admit card to the exam centre. No candidate will be allowed to leave the exam hall before the exam ends. Eligibility verified at the time of application is provisional; final document verification will be done by the concerned department, not by MPESB. Any legal dispute regarding this recruitment falls under the jurisdiction of the Madhya Pradesh High Court only.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: MPESB has officially released the Group-2 Sub-Group-4 rulebook (niyam pustika) covering the Patwari PwD category recruitment along with other departmental posts under the same combined exam. The Patwari-specific chapter of the notification lays out the vacancy distribution, eligibility conditions, age limit, and reservation details exclusively for this 200-post PwD recruitment drive. Candidates should download and read the official notification PDF from the MPESB website before applying, since document verification will be based strictly on the conditions mentioned in it. content_sections.heading: MPESB Patwari Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: MPESB has notified a total of 200 Patwari vacancies under this recruitment, and all 200 posts are reserved for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) candidates. These posts are further sub-divided by disability category: Hearing Impairment (EH), Locomotor Disability (LD), and Multiple Disability/Autism/Intellectual Disability/Mental Illness (MD). Candidates with visual impairment are not eligible for the Patwari post as per the applicable Revenue Department order. The vacancies are spread across 44 districts of Madhya Pradesh, and candidates must indicate their district preference at the time of application. EH = Hearing Impaired, LD = Locomotor Disability, MD = Multiple Disability/Autism/Intellectual Disability/Mental Illness. Candidates must select their district preference in order at the time of application, as this preference cannot be changed once the application is submitted.

content_sections.heading: MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the qualification, age, and category-specific conditions below to be eligible for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026. To apply for the MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026, candidates need a graduate degree from a recognised university in any discipline. In addition, candidates must hold a CPCT (Computer Proficiency Certification Test) score card along with Hindi typing qualification. Candidates who have not cleared CPCT at the time of selection will be allowed to appear for it, but they must clear it within 3 years of their probation period after appointment, failing which the appointment will be cancelled. The age limit for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026 (PwD category, for permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh) is 18 to 45 years. Age will be calculated as on 1 January 2026. Additional age relaxations mentioned elsewhere in the general Group-2 Sub-Group-4 rules (for ex-servicemen, retrenched government employees, and other specified categories) may also apply; candidates should verify their individual eligibility against the full notification. Since this recruitment is specifically for the PwD/Divyang category, candidates must hold a valid disability certificate issued by a competent authority in one of the eligible categories: Hearing Impairment (EH), Locomotor Disability (LD), or Multiple Disability/Autism/Intellectual Disability/Mental Illness (MD). Visually impaired candidates are not eligible for the Patwari post. Candidates must also be Indian citizens and permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh; candidates who are not permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh cannot apply for this PwD-reserved Patwari recruitment. Live registration with a Madhya Pradesh State Employment Office (Rozgar Karyalay) is mandatory for all applicants.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a special recruitment drive by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board for 200 Patwari posts reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD/Divyang category), conducted under the Group-2 Sub-Group-4 Combined Recruitment Examination 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 200 Patwari vacancies are available, distributed across 44 districts of Madhya Pradesh and reserved for the PwD/Divyang category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application last date is 18 August 2026. Corrections to the submitted form can be made until 23 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need a graduate degree from a recognised university, along with a CPCT score card with Hindi typing (or the ability to clear it within 3 years of probation after appointment).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 45 years as on 1 January 2026 for Madhya Pradesh permanent resident candidates applying under this PwD category recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 250 for MP domicile SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD candidates, plus an additional MP Online portal fee of Rs. 20–60 depending on the mode of submission.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Indian citizens who are permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh, hold a graduate degree, and have a valid disability certificate in the Hearing Impairment, Locomotor Disability, or Multiple Disability/Autism/Intellectual Disability/Mental Illness category are eligible. Visually impaired candidates are not eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply online for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official MPESB website, www.esb.mp.gov.in, between 4 August 2026 and 18 August 2026. Offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for MPESB Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 200-mark computer-based online exam, followed by a percentile-based merit list, district allotment through a single round of counselling, and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for MPESB Patwari?
faq.answer: The Patwari post carries a pay scale of Rs. 5,200–20,200 with Grade Pay of Rs. 2,100, with a graded stipend of 70%, 80%, and 90% of the minimum pay during the three-year probation period.
